It was won by [[Kruger United F.C.|Kruger United]].{{Cite web |last=Rabothe |first=Tshepo |date=May 2, 2026 |title=Kruger United seal Betway Premiership automatic promotion |url=https://farpost.co.za/2026/05/02/kruger-united-seal-betway-premiership-automatic-promotion/ |access-date=2026-05-03 |website=FARPost |language=en-US}} [[Baroka F.C.|Baroka]] and [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] were relegated.{{Cite web |last=Rabothe |first=Tshepo |date=May 10, 2026 |title=Black Leopards join Baroka in amateur league, CT City continue promotion chase |url=https://farpost.co.za/2026/05/10/black-leopards-join-baroka-in-amateur-league/ |access-date=2026-05-10 |website=FARPost |language=en-US}} ==Teams== ===Team changes=== The following teams changes took place since the 2024–25 season.
